question: On exactly the R-510 H and R-511 cylinder domain D, is every symmetric strongly continuous Markov semigroup whose generator extends A equal to the R-512/R-567 minimal semigroup?

exact_scope.H: Exactly the real gauge-invariant L2 space of the R-510 anchored probability law; the anchor-preserving automorphism group is identity.
exact_scope.D: Exactly the R-511 algebraic union of bounded gauge-invariant globally amplitude-l1-Lipschitz finite-prefix cylinders, including constants.
exact_scope.A: The R-511 derived PH/LK/AP sum c_r Delta_r, c_r=m_r exp(-Delta F/2); retain coincident K=2 directed PH/LK labels separately and exact AP partial domains. Amplitudes are fixed by this operator; no radial rate acceleration.
exact_scope.parameters: OMC-016 fixed_parameters: K=2, M_s=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=theta=0, all other displayed couplings one.
exact_scope.geometry: The specified anchored two-row half-strip. Each finite-prefix rate uses the original eventual triangular incidence. No other width, spatial dimension, exhaustion, physical volume or continuum is asserted.
exact_scope.state_and_order: R-510 labelled all-Q product-dr/counting local law obtained first j->infinity at fixed n, then anchored n. No new state limit is taken and no original finite-semigroup convergence is asserted.
exact_scope.time: The existing external stochastic parameter t>=0, not quantum, proper or Lorentzian time.
exact_scope.target_extension: The R-512 minimal closed form and its spectral semigroup, with the full-domain Markov/conservation repair in R-567.

extension_class.quantifier: ALL strongly continuous contraction semigroups S_t on the SAME H, symmetric in its scalar product, positive and L-infinity contractive, with closed generator G satisfying D subset Dom(G) and Gf=Af for every f in D.
extension_class.constants: Conservation is to follow from 1 in D and A1=0; it is not obtained by conditioning a killed extension.
extension_class.no_hidden_restriction: Do not assume Dom(G) is the minimal operator domain, or that its form domain equals the R-512 minimal domain. Do not assume a graph core, essential self-adjointness, a path-space realization or a prescribed boundary extension.
extension_class.equality_target: For every f in D and every finite T, sup_(0<=t<=T) ||S_t f-T_min(t)f||_H=0, and hence equality on all H by density and contraction.
extension_class.negative_target: Two members of the declared class with a common f in H and t>0 on which their H values differ; a different model or non-Markov self-adjoint extension is not a counterexample.

bounded_attempt.route: Try radial invariant localization, state-derived tempered rate bounds, and a finite-root backward-test boundary estimate that compares every declared extension. This is a proof route, not an extra hypothesis or accepted theorem.
bounded_attempt.proof_localization: Only increasing amplitude-measurable events of full limiting probability may be used, without conditioning or replacing the state. Finite-root sums are auxiliary tests formed from the exact A summands, not substitute PAH Hamiltonians or finite-volume convergence evidence.
necessary_bridges: Every extension fixes the full radial L2 subspace and commutes with bounded radial indicator multipliers.
The R-510 exact transfer envelope supplies a column-uniform amplitude tail bound; rates and dependence counts are derived from the source functional and incidence.
Localized finite-root backward tests belong to the domain of EVERY candidate G by the original D and generator closedness, not an assumed new core.
The residual boundary generator tends to zero uniformly on each finite time interval after growing support; remove localization in the original H.
bounded_attempt.budget: One bounded analytic route and its independent/hostile verification package, then REVIEW_REQUIRED. No unchanged owner scan, old finite-table replay or replacement model.
bounded_attempt.hold: If a bridge cannot be proved, record its exact missing statement, scope and changed-evidence reentry condition. HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE is not a uniqueness theorem.

acceptance: Exact proof for the full declared extension class, or an exact pair of distinct extensions, with all inherited assumptions named.
Separate primary, non-importing independent and hostile evidence; executable checks do not replace analytic domain and limit arguments.
Lean where feasible, with an explicit list of formalized and unformalized propositions; no assumed uniqueness in a formalization.
One exploration decision and result record with source hashes, reproduction commands, falsifiers, non-claims and one next question; synthesis only at a logical checkpoint.
non_claims: No proof of original finite-to-target ordered convergence or repair of PAH-OMC-020 owner/comparison gaps.
No changed model, functional, rate, state, projection, time scale, root multiplicity or limit order; no Q3LOCK import.
No physical Pre-A, Sector-A closure, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, causal cone, Yang-Mills, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
No mainline or claim-tier promotion from an auxiliary extension theorem alone.
